metadata.name: seek_protocol
metadata.description: Seek Protocol - real-world scavenger hunts with SKR rewards on Solana

accept, atomically swapping `authority` and clearing `pending_authority`.

instructions.name: accept_bounty
docs: Accept a legacy v1 bounty - player submits their entry and starts the
hunt. entry_amount must be exactly LEGACY_TIER_1_ENTRY /
LEGACY_TIER_2_ENTRY / LEGACY_TIER_3_ENTRY (1000 / 3000 / 5000 SKR in
base units). New clients should call accept_bounty_v2 with an explicit
tier.
mission_commitment is hash(mission_id || salt) for commit-reveal.
timestamp must be within 60 seconds of current time (for PDA derivation).

instructions.name: close_bounty
docs: Close a bounty account after it reaches a terminal state + 24h cooldown.
Refunds rent to the player. The cooldown prevents PDA reuse races — the
bounty PDA seed is [b"bounty", player, timestamp] so after close, the
same (player, timestamp) can be re-init'd. 24h is plenty of slack for
any in-flight finalizer retries or downstream indexer catch-up.

instructions.name: dispute_bounty

Legacy dispute path. With a zero-length window, public disputes are
effectively disabled until the economics are redesigned.

instructions.name: propose_authority_transfer
docs: Step 1 of two-step authority transfer. Current authority proposes a new
authority; no state changes until the new authority signs `accept_authority_transfer`.
Overwrites any previously pending transfer.

instructions.name: set_hot_authority
docs: Rotate the hot authority (used for reveal_mission + propose_resolution).
Cold authority only. Used when the backend keypair is compromised or rotated.

instructions.name: set_protocol_paused
docs: Pause or resume new bounty acceptance. Cold authority only.
Does not block reveal/propose/finalize/cancel paths for already-active bounties.

accounts.name: authority
docs: Cold authority setting the pause flag.

accounts.name: global_state
docs: Global state PDA.

instructions.name: set_treasury
docs: Rotate the protocol_treasury recipient. Cold authority only.
Used when the fees-wallet key is compromised, lost, or operationally rotated.
`new_treasury` must be a TokenAccount of SKR_MINT (validated in the
account context). Only redirects FUTURE inflows — funds already in the
old treasury stay under that account's owner.

accounts.name: new_treasury_owner
docs: New treasury owner. Unchecked because future custody could be a
program-owned multisig/PDA; constraints below bind the key to the token
account owner and canonical ATA.

instructions.name: withdraw_singularity
docs: Withdraw Singularity bonus funds. Cold authority only, only while paused,
and only after all active bounties have resolved. This is an explicit
public emergency/admin operation, not a hidden path.

types.name: GlobalState
docs: Global protocol state - tracks all protocol-wide metrics

fields.name: authority
docs: Cold authority. Signs admin ops: fund_house, set_protocol_paused,
withdraw_unreserved_house, withdraw_singularity, set_hot_authority,
set_treasury, propose/accept/cancel_authority_transfer, resolve_dispute.
Should be a hardware wallet (Ledger) on mainnet.

fields.name: hot_authority
docs: Hot authority. Signs hot-path ops: reveal_mission, propose_resolution.
Backend-held. Compromise is contained: cannot drain treasury or rotate authority.

fields.name: pending_authority
docs: Pending authority for two-step transfer. `Pubkey::default()` = no transfer in-flight.
Set by `propose_authority_transfer`, cleared by `accept_authority_transfer`
or `cancel_authority_transfer`.

fields.name: house_vault
docs: House vault token account (PDA-owned)

fields.name: singularity_vault
docs: Singularity bonus vault token account (PDA-owned)

fields.name: protocol_treasury
docs: Protocol treasury token account

fields.name: house_fund_balance
docs: Total SKR currently in house vault

fields.name: active_payout_liability
docs: Sum of full payout liabilities for active bounties not yet finalized,
dispute-resolved, or cancelled. New bounties are accepted only if the
vault can cover every active bounty as a win.

fields.name: active_bounty_count
docs: Number of active bounties contributing to active_payout_liability.

fields.name: singularity_balance
docs: Total SKR in Singularity bonus pool

fields.name: total_burned
docs: Total SKR burned forever

fields.name: total_bounties_created
docs: Total bounties created

fields.name: total_bounties_won
docs: Total bounties won by players

fields.name: total_bounties_lost
docs: Total bounties lost by players

fields.name: total_singularity_wins
docs: Total Singularity bonuses awarded

fields.name: paused
docs: Emergency switch. When true, new accept_bounty calls are rejected.

fields.name: bump
docs: Bump seed for PDA derivation
